about: A town's own figures as a resident says them in passing, read after "with" ("With {town_figure}, {place} would feel it."): one noun phrase per comparison the director makes from world-metrics (the town's unemployment against the country's from the macro months, and a year of the town's typical rent against its typical household's earnings, against HUD's cost-burden line). Never a figure: people do not quote rates at home.
author: Words builder (words-opening-evening-talk-raises-what-the-president-said)

figures.town-jobs-high: more people out of work than most places
figures.town-jobs-low: fewer people out of work than most places
figures.town-rent-high: rents that take too much of a paycheck
figures.town-rent-low: rents most folks can still manage
